citation: George Glessner, [Wirt Dexter house, 1721 S. Prairie Avenue, before the front addition], c. 1888. Photograph in the Glessner House Museum's George Glessner photographs, reproduced on its blog, 'The Early History of Prairie Avenue - Part IV' (2020-07-07).
author: George Glessner
repository: Glessner House Museum (George Glessner photographs), via its blog. Prairie library image a16-ghm-blog-1721-dexter-c1888 (stream-1600-1700.json).
locator: The gas street lamp in the right foreground, standing on the west parkway of Prairie Avenue near the camera, which is opposite 1721.
rights_note: An unpublished photograph by George Glessner (d. 1929), public domain in the US by term; the museum's terms for its scan were requested 2026-10-02 and are pending. Only the lamp's place and form are read; nothing is derived as an asset.
access_notes: Read 2026-10-27 (T-3199) from the image store's reference copy (kevinrhaas/chicago-images, prairie-1904/files/a16-ghm-blog-1721-dexter-c1888.jpg); the original host is not reachable from the build containers.
note: Winter view across the avenue; the lamp is the one nearest the camera on the walk's own side.
what_it_supplies: a gas street lamp on the west parkway of Prairie Avenue opposite 1721, and its form: fluted post, ladder bar, tapered four-sided lantern under a pyramidal cap
what_it_does_not_supply: the lamp's exact place along the block: it stands near the camera
